objective: Reduce remaining general compiler overhead using native profiles and unchanged official V8 benchmarks.
evidence: initial-pc-samples.json; current baseline's native compiler profile, 32959 included ticks and zero unaccounted ticks

protocol.isolation: Builds, tests, profiles and benchmarks run serially. Read-only source analysis may overlap.
protocol.cost_diagnostic: Each valid candidate: six fixed alternating AB/BA pairs after one warmup per binary, unchanged official DataView suite with synchronous phase statistics.
protocol.official_compiler: Each correctness- and native-validated candidate: twelve fixed alternating pairs on unchanged official Compiler, all nine cases reported, regardless of diagnostic outcome.
protocol.runtime: Candidate retained on official Compiler evidence: twenty-one fixed stock DataView pairs, all six cases reported.
protocol.checkpoints: Unsigned source and result commits for every experiment, including neutral or rejected candidates.
protocol.selection: Start experiments independently from the preserved baseline. Do not stack unmeasured changes. Smaller code or fewer sampled ticks alone is not proof of a speedup.
protocol.statistics: Existing paired runner: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples, seed 20261021; report intervals and AB/BA order splits, retain every round.

experiments.hypothesis: GraphReducer decodes an epoch-based node mark, clamps older epochs to zero and narrows to uint8 before comparing. Compare full encoded marks directly for equality and greater-than while preserving zero and old-epoch semantics.
experiments.evidence: ReduceTop: 2182 self ticks, 6.62% of included compiler samples; native code has subtract/cmov/byte-test sequences at all three input scans.
experiments.safety: Keep traversal, self guards, revisit queue checks and input rescans. Preserve bounds assertions; explicitly test old epochs beyond 256 marks and logical zero.

experiments.hypothesis: The reducer's safepoint poll contains a dependent test/set/or/test sequence for running-and-requested. Investigate moving the parked-state guard to the cold path, without removing polls or weakening atomic ordering.
experiments.evidence: Reduce: 1849 self ticks, 5.61% of included compiler samples. 700 samples at the three request/predicate test-or instructions, with additional nearby samples.
experiments.safety: Source review must establish parked-state and asynchronous request semantics before selecting an implementation. GC correctness takes precedence over native code size.

limits: Hardware perf counters remain denied. V8 native sampler PCs identify sampled code, not precise instruction latency or branch counts. Profiling-only source-position wrappers are excluded as stock optimization targets.
